title: Pretrained MoE Expert Extraction, Pruning und 16-GB-VRAM-Distillation (Kolibri-first)
purpose: Vortrainierte MoE-Modelle modellagnostisch analysieren, Expertengruppen selektiv extrahieren, Router konsistent reduzieren, funktional evaluieren und auf fester 16-GB-VRAM-GPU möglichst qualitätserhaltend betreiben; zunächst Kolibri 1 als Forschungsadapter.
constraints: Niemals annehmen, dass einzelne Experten eigenständig vollständige LLMs sind: Attention, Embeddings, Shared Experts, Norms und Router bleiben relevant.
Experten-IDs sind pro Layer spezifisch; keine globalen Experten ohne explizite Modellunterstützung.
Die Reduktion verändert meist die Modellfunktion. Keine Qualitäts- oder Geschwindigkeitsversprechen ohne reproduzierbare Messung.
16 GiB VRAM als hartes Ziel für vollständige GPU-Residency, separat RAM-Offload-Pfad bis 64 GiB; KV-Cache, Runtime-Overhead und Kontext mitzählen.
Keine automatische produktive Aktivierung ohne Tests, nachvollziehbare Provenance und Rollback.
Originalmodell bleibt unverändert; abgeleitete Artefakte sind versioniert und reproduzierbar.
Lizenz und Modellnutzungsbedingungen vor Download, Transformation und Verteilung automatisch prüfen.
existing_code_reuse: worker/training/growth/transforms.py: upcycle(), prune_experts() nur auf eigener Tiny-Referenzarchitektur; nicht als generische HF/Kolibri-Unterstützung ausgeben.
todos/active/todo.codecompass-dmoe-parametric-knowledge-injection.json: separate LoRA-/Knowledge-Experts; andere Semantik, nur gemeinsame Verträge/Registry nutzen.
llama.cpp-vision-decision und Jev-Parallel-Decision-TODOs: optionaler Inferenzvergleich, keine implizite MTP-Unterstützung.

architecture.adapters: MoEArchitectureAdapter für HF config/safetensors, Layer/Router/Expert layout, shared_experts, attention, tensor mapping, GGUF export probes; Kolibri-first, keine blind angenommenen Tensor-Namen.
pipeline: per-layer router activation traces on DE/EN and coding workloads
candidate selection (frequency, diversity, contribution, task-conditional, random controls)
signed immutable release candidate; explicit rollback
architecture.runtime: Compare whole-model 16 GiB GPU placement, CPU+GPU offload and original MoE; model-specific llama.cpp/vision-decision support must be checked rather than assumed.
modes: dynamic expert paging/caching without removing model experts
optional multiple reduced models sharing immutable base where compatible

tasks.title: Kolibri 1 Architektur und Lizenz verifizieren
acceptance: Pin official config, model revision, tensor inventory, license and tokenizer.
Document routed/shared experts, layers, top-k and inference implementation.
Determine current HF/vLLM and llama.cpp compatibility with actual smoke results.

tasks.title: Generische MoE-Introspektion und Adaptervertrag
acceptance: List exact expert tensors per layer with shapes, sizes and router maps.
Reject unknown layouts fail-closed.
No mutation of upstream safetensors.

tasks.title: Realistische 16-GB-VRAM-Speicherplanung
acceptance: Estimate weights, router, shared layers, KV cache, quantization overhead, context sizes 4k/16k/32k.
Report full-GPU feasible vs hybrid vs impossible.
Model eGPU transfer and CPU/RAM bandwidth impact, measured where available.

tasks.title: Router-Telemetrie auf repräsentativen Aufgaben
acceptance: Capture layer-wise selection counts, token-conditioned activations, confidence and expert overlap.
Freeze German, English, code, tool-use and structured-decision datasets.
Prove routing logging does not leak sensitive prompts.

tasks.title: Mehrere Expert-Selektionsstrategien
acceptance: Compare activation frequency, contribution ablation, diverse coverage, random and task-specific subsets.
Select distinct experts per layer subject to memory budget.
Avoid overfitting via validation/holdout split.

tasks.title: Checkpoint-Extraktion, Router-Remapping, Metadaten
acceptance: Produce new isolated checkpoint with tensor integrity checks, mapping manifest and source digests.
Correct remapped router outputs, expert indexing and top-k constraints.
Load and generate test cases without shape mismatch/NaN.

tasks.title: Erholungstraining und Knowledge-Distillation optional
acceptance: Compare zero-shot pruning versus calibration/fine-tuning/distillation.
Use bounded small-scale experiments before Kolibri-scale training.
Track catastrophic forgetting and unchanged holdout.

tasks.title: Quantisierung und GPU-Offload kombinieren
acceptance: Compare supported Q4/Q3 or equivalent formats against reduced expert counts.
Validate target runtime and memory residency, no format promises.
Record tokens/s, p50/p95 latency, RSS, VRAM, energy where measurable.

tasks.title: Decision-Runner-Kompatibilität getrennt evaluieren
acceptance: Verify Kolibri architecture conversion/inference support before coupling.
Compare normal decoding, constrained JSON, direct choice/scoring and parallel-decision paths for same tasks.
MTP/speculative-decoding only if model/runtime demonstrably supports it; validate probability calibration and correctness.

tasks.title: Ananta-Registry, Evolver und CodeCompass anbinden
acceptance: Reuse research artifacts, immutable model digests, policy gates and benchmark promotion.
Evolver searches reduction variants under fixed GPU budget; no unsupported automatic production deploy.
CodeCompass provides representative coding tasks, test outcomes and regression signals.

tasks.title: A/B Benchmark und Abbruchkriterien
acceptance: Compare original hybrid-offloaded model, reduced MoE, smaller dense/MoE alternatives and identical multi-agent workflows.
Measure quality, error types, coding unit-test pass, German-language fidelity, tokens/s and end-to-end completion time.
Define Pareto frontier quality vs GPU residency vs latency and reject if significantly inferior.

tasks.title: Reproduzierbarkeit, Security und Dokumentation
acceptance: Track seeds, dataset license, exact revision, checkpoint hashes, commands, machine hardware.
Negative tests on poisoned models, malformed tensor maps, unwanted weight rewriting, memory oversubscription.
Write operator guide, recovery/rollback and evidence-backed go/no-go.

success_criteria: At least one correctly loaded reduced derivative with full provenance and reproducible checkpoint conversion.
Measurements on real 16-GB-VRAM eGPU determine if full residency is possible without excluding KV cache.
Benchmark reports explicitly quantify quality loss or gain vs same-model baseline; no unverified claims.
Clear keep/reject decision for Kolibri extraction and documented adapter path for other MoE families.
